instruction: Disable the VS Code setting that automatically focuses the workbench window when the debugger hits a breakpoint.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated VS Code Settings, searched 'debug focus', found and unchecked 'Debug: Focus Editor On Break' in 3 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VS Code Settings, search for specific settings by keyword, toggle checkbox settings, understand debug-related options.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the same debug focus setting area. The model saw both 'Focus Editor On Break' and 'Focus Window On Break' in the trajectory; this variation targets the adjacent setting.
metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling debug.focusWindowOnBreak in VS Code settings. Evaluator reads settings.json via vm_file and checks the setting value using check_json_settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads VS Code user settings from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json via get_vm_file
Metric check_json_settings correctly receives rules dict as expected parameter and accesses expected['expected'] to get the settings to verify
Setting name debug.focusWindowOnBreak is the correct VS Code setting for focusing the window when debugger hits a breakpoint
Expected value false correctly represents 'disabled' as required by the instruction
Complete coverage: single requirement (disable one setting) fully verified by the evaluator

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
